description: Wazuh Security Monitoring Dashboard for Meta-Env Infrastructure
title: Wazuh Security Monitoring - Meta-Env
readme:
This is a placeholder dashboard for Wazuh security monitoring.

To set up full Wazuh integration:

1. Install Wazuh Prometheus Exporter:
   - GitHub: https://github.com/pyToshka/wazuh-prometheus-exporter
   - Configure on Server 60 (192.168.1.60:9999)

2. Import official Wazuh dashboard:
   - Dashboard ID: 22448 (Wazuh Summary)
   - Dashboard ID: 21565 (SIEM XDR Wazuh)

3. Configure Wazuh agents on all servers:
   - Server 60 (backup): Monitoring & Dashboard host
   - Server 61 (okamih): Production e-commerce - CRITICAL
   - Server 62 (cpall): Web hosting

Security Monitoring Features:
- File integrity monitoring (FIM)
- Intrusion detection (IDS)
- Log analysis
- Vulnerability detection
- Configuration assessment
- Security compliance monitoring

References:
- Wazuh Documentation: https://documentation.wazuh.com/
- Prometheus Exporter: https://github.com/pyToshka/wazuh-prometheus-exporter
- SERVERS.md: /home/user/meta-env/SERVERS.md
